questions.question: Can you describe your experience leading technical teams on enterprise-wide systems, including how you assigned work, set priorities, and kept stakeholders informed?

In your role at Broadridge, you managed hardware and software refresh projects for the Business Intelligence Competency Center. How did you plan these projects to minimize operational risk and maintain service availability?
Describe the UI fraud detection project you managed from the BICC perspective. What were your responsibilities, and how did you work with other teams to deliver it?

This role requires building secure, scalable, and reliable payment-platform services. How have you incorporated security, performance, backup/recovery, and high availability into the systems you have supported?
Tell us about your experience with SQL Server, Oracle, or Sybase performance tuning. Can you provide an example of a difficult query or database performance issue you diagnosed and resolved?
What Java development experience do you have, and how recently have you used Java to build, maintain, test, or troubleshoot production applications?
Describe your work on the Accounts Receivable Collection System automated processes. What parts of analysis, development, testing, production monitoring, and code fixes did you personally handle?

How have you designed or operated clustered and virtualized environments using technologies such as SQL clustering, Windows clustering, Hyper-V, or VMware? What availability or scalability goals did those designs address?
Give an example of a major upgrade, migration, or conversion you led. How did you assess dependencies, test the change, coordinate vendors or internal teams, and manage rollback or recovery?

This position involves close collaboration across engineering and business functions. How would you translate business requirements for small-business payment workflows into technical priorities, architecture decisions, and an executable delivery plan?
